title: ר' חנינא הגדול

paragraphs: R. Chanina the Great, grandfather of R. Chanina bar Chama. According to the statement above that Chama was R. Chanina ben Dosa's son, this R. Chanina the Great would be R. Chanina ben Dosa. But this requires investigation, for it is impossible: R. Chanina ben Dosa lived in the aforementioned R. Yochanan ben Zakkai's days. Yet we find R. Chanina Kara before R. Chanina the Great, and also before R. Yannai, whose student was R. Yochanan. R. Chiyya bar Avin sent: “So too R. Elazar taught us in R. Chanina the Great's name”—Yevamot 43a.
